3D Graphics in the Cloud

On June 15th, 2011, the Hasso-Plattner-Institute held the Spring Future SOC Lab Day 2011. A selection of projects that have been run at the HPI Future SOC Lab has been presented. Prof. Jürgen Döllner, head of the Computer Graphics Systems Group, gave a talk on “Interactive 3D Graphics in the Cloud” and presented ideas and first results of recent work in the field of service-oriented and cloud-based geovisualization systems.
